description: VQE optimization of 20-qubit binary MERA (5 layers, 190 params, H-gate init) to critical Ising GS (J=h=1, OBC N=20). v2: H-gate initialization, 10-seed COBYLA + 2-phase polish. AerEstimator(approx=True). Step 3 of HYP-2026-002. Key finding: MERA converges to ferromagnetic product state; ZZ connected correlators near-zero at r>=2. Architecture revision required.

circuit.causal_cone: 5 layers covers dr=1..32 (full range for N=20)
circuit.init_note: H gates before MERA: |+>^N start, target <Z>=0

state_analysis.diagnosis: MERA converges to ferromagnetic product state despite H-gate init. Real-valued MERA ansatz lacks Z2 symmetry protection. C_connected(r>=2)=0 means no multi-site entanglement captured. Requires symmetry-enforced or ZX-calculus MERA.

force_profile.note: V~0 because MERA in ferromagnetic product state, not critical GS

fit.error: V(dr) signals ~0: MERA state not converged to critical GS
fit.diagnosis: Holographic fit requires V(dr) ~ C1 - C2*exp(-dr/xi). Current V~0 everywhere. Classical V(dr=1)=-0.345 is the target scale.

comparison.expressibility_note: 5-layer 20q ceiling ~1.76% vs 3-layer 16q ~1.87%. Slight improvement. Both circuits fail to produce critical correlations: C_connected(r>=2)~0. Root cause: real-valued binary MERA lacks Z2 symmetry protection for TFIM.

classical_comparison.interpretation: 1.4% of classical signal captured at dr=1; 0% at dr>=2

comparison.normalization_note: Paper C1=0.08, C2=13.6 uses different normalization than C_two - C_vac. Classical V(dr=1)=-0.345 vs AdS prediction V(dr=1)=-6.72. Direct comparison requires matching normalization conventions.

feasibility.recommendation: H2 at 7.33% error budget (CX=38) within 10% PoC threshold. But architecture revision needed before hardware run is meaningful. Symmetry-enforced MERA would likely use similar CX count.

next_steps.priority_1: Symmetry-enforced MERA: enforce Z2 symmetry in circuit ansatz to prevent ferromagnetic local minimum collapse
next_steps.priority_2: Measure XX correlators with Rz hologrons: current state has <X>=0.53 (Rz rotates in ZY plane, modifies X-basis correlations)
next_steps.priority_3: 7+ layer MERA on 32 qubits: deeper architecture with full causal cone at N=32 for proper holographic limit
next_steps.priority_4: Match paper normalization: resolve C1/C2 convention difference before comparing to C1=0.08, C2=13.6, l_AdS=1.443
